items.title: Late Field Goal Lifts Minnesota to 20-17 Win and Bowl Eligibility
items.summary: With the win, Minnesota (6-5, 4-4 in the Big Ten) becomes bowl-eligible for the eighth time in head coach P.J. Fleck's 10 seasons with the program.

items.summary: It was another walkoff field goal for Luke Drzewiecki to give the Minnesota Gophers the win over Northwestern 20-17. After Northwestern scored a game-tying touchdown with just 32 seconds left in the fourth quarter, Drake Lindsey led the Gopher offense on a 49-yard drive to set up the Drzewiecki 44-yard winner.
